scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @fitmybike/shared build && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @fitmybike/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @fitmybike/api dev" "pnpm --filter @fitmybike/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fitmybike/shared build && pnpm --filter @fitmybike/api build && pnpm --filter @fitmybike/web build
scripts.openapi: pnpm --filter @fitmybike/shared build && pnpm --filter @fitmybike/api openapi && openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o packages/shared/src/api-types.ts && pnpm --filter @fitmybike/shared build
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm openapi && git diff --exit-code apps/api/openapi.json packages/shared/src/api-types.ts
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @fitmybike/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @fitmybike/api exec prisma migrate reset
